name: ink-morrow
description: Playable fiction: follow the cast, steer the story, explore a living world

scripts.lint: node node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js backend frontend e2e prototypes scripts/serve-recovery-prototype.cjs scripts/build-recovery-preview.cjs
scripts.test:prototype: cd e2e && node run-playwright.cjs test --config recovery-playwright.config.cjs
scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run test:setup && npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:coverage: cd backend && npm run test:coverage && cd ../frontend && npm run test:coverage
